about: The crew's helper scripts and when Botyard runs them. Read by studio/server/lib/timetable.mjs. A timer has `every` (30s, 5m, 1h) counted from the last `start` or `finish`, with `first` as the wait after the service starts; or `at` (`Mon 08:00`, `04:30`, `*:05,35`), with `catchUp` to run a time that passed while the service was off. A keeper is kept running. `limit` is how long one run may take.

jobs.name: review-guard
jobs.what: Sends each finished build to its check, acts on the verdict, and wakes jobs that are stuck. Uses no AI.

jobs.name: wait
jobs.what: Wakes build sessions whose heavy job has finished. Uses no AI.

jobs.name: fallback
jobs.what: Moves bots to another AI while theirs is out of its limit, and back again.

jobs.name: token-guard
jobs.what: Pauses Claude bots at your token limit, so the week's allowance lasts.

jobs.name: away
jobs.what: Keeps the router's port open so the phone app reaches Botyard away from home.

jobs.name: free-scout
jobs.what: Looks for new free models every morning, tests them and adds the ones that work.

jobs.name: not-in-main
jobs.what: Lists every job marked done whose code is still not in main (a merge that failed, a second repo nobody merged, a hold never ruled on), so the page shows it as Done, not in main. Read-only on the repos. Uses no AI.

jobs.name: sandbox-roots
jobs.what: Takes out of the Codex bots' sandbox config any folder that no longer exists (a retired or moved repository), which would otherwise make every sandboxed shell command fail. Uses no AI.

jobs.name: folder-check
jobs.what: Checks that every bot runs in a folder that exists, with access to exactly the folders its jobs need, and that no refused call goes unseen. Reports; never changes a config. Uses no AI.

jobs.name: github-projects
jobs.what: Adds a Botyard project for each of your GitHub repos that looks like a real project (rules: github-project-rules.json). Read-only on GitHub, never clones. Uses no AI.

jobs.name: edge
jobs.what: Botyard's private link to Cloudflare, for the phone app away from home.

jobs.name: grade-new-models
jobs.what: New free models get their published coding grade (SWE-bench Verified against Claude) asked for, once: one job for the lead when any has none.
